, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In compiling the initial list of gyms within 200m of Tompkins Square Park, they omitted the correct gyms (CrossFit East River and Avea Pilates, which have pre-7am classes) and included at least one gym likely outside the 200m radius (TMPL).
